bio: Take some time to pamper yourself with a tranquil Afternoon Tea experience at Dakota. This luxurious boutique hotel is situated in the heart of Leeds city centre, offering an array of quintessential tea time treats.  Enjoy your Afternoon Tea in the Cocktail Lounge, which features ambient lighting, modern decor and a luxurious atmosphere.  Dakota serve a classic Afternoon Tea featuring delicate finger sandwiches, homemade cakes and scones served with thick Devonshire clotted cream. Sparkling wines and cocktails are available to add an extra touch of decadence to the proceedings.  Dakota is situated in Leeds city centre, with Leeds train station within a short walking distance.
